# SDF Library

## Overview

This chapter provides ready-to-use signed distance functions. For derivations and explanations, see the **Deriving SDFs** chapter. Here we focus on usage.

Each shape appears in two forms:

**Bare function** — for quick use and one-off shapes:
```glsl
float d = sdSphere(p - center, radius);
```

**Struct + overloaded `sdf`** — for scene building with `getMaterial`:
```glsl
Sphere ball = Sphere(vec3(0), 1.0, vec3(1, 0, 0));
float d = sdf(p, ball);
vec3 color = ball.color;
```

GLSL's function overloading lets us use `sdf(p, shape)` for any shape type. The compiler dispatches based on the struct.


## 2D Primitives

### Circle

```glsl
float sdCircle(vec2 p, float r) {
    return length(p) - r;
}
```

```glsl
struct Circle {
    vec2 center;
    float radius;
};

float sdf(vec2 p, Circle c) {
    return length(p - c.center) - c.radius;
}
```


### Box (2D)

```glsl
float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 halfSize) {
    vec2 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}
```

```glsl
struct Box2D {
    vec2 center;
    vec2 halfSize;
};

float sdf(vec2 p, Box2D b) {
    vec2 d = abs(p - b.center) - b.halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}
```


### Segment (2D)

Distance to a line segment. Always non-negative (no interior).

```glsl
float sdSegment(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b) {
    vec2 pa = p - a, ba = b - a;
    float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * t);
}
```


### Ring (2D)

Hollowed circle — an annulus.

```glsl
float sdRing(vec2 p, float R, float thickness) {
    return abs(length(p) - R) - thickness;
}
```


### Triangle (Equilateral)

```glsl
float sdTriangle(vec2 p, float r) {
    p.x = abs(p.x);
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0)/2.0)), 0.0)
             * vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0)/2.0);
    p.x = abs(p.x);
    return -(p.y + r * 0.5);
}
```


## 3D Primitives

### Sphere

```glsl
float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) {
    return length(p) - r;
}
```

```glsl
struct Sphere {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Sphere s) {
    return length(p - s.center) - s.radius;
}
```


### Box (3D)

```glsl
float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}
```

```glsl
struct Box {
    vec3 center;
    vec3 halfSize;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Box b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p - b.center) - b.halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}
```


### Rounded Box

```glsl
float sdRoundBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize, float r) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - (halfSize - r);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0) - r;
}
```

```glsl
struct RoundBox {
    vec3 center;
    vec3 halfSize;
    float rounding;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, RoundBox b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p - b.center) - (b.halfSize - b.rounding);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0) - b.rounding;
}
```


### Plane

Horizontal plane at height $h$:

```glsl
float sdPlane(vec3 p, float h) {
    return p.y - h;
}
```

General plane with unit normal $\mathbf{n}$:

```glsl
float sdPlane(vec3 p, vec3 n, float h) {
    return dot(p, n) - h;
}
```

```glsl
struct Plane {
    vec3 normal;
    float offset;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Plane pl) {
    return dot(p, pl.normal) - pl.offset;
}
```


### Cylinder (Capped)

Vertical cylinder with radius $r$ and half-height $h$:

```glsl
float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}
```

```glsl
struct Cylinder {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    float halfHeight;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Cylinder c) {
    vec3 q = p - c.center;
    vec2 d = vec2(length(q.xz) - c.radius, abs(q.y) - c.halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}
```


### Torus

Major radius $R$ (ring), minor radius $r$ (tube):

```glsl
float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
    return length(q) - r;
}
```

```glsl
struct Torus {
    vec3 center;
    float majorRadius;
    float minorRadius;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Torus t) {
    vec3 q = p - t.center;
    vec2 d = vec2(length(q.xz) - t.majorRadius, q.y);
    return length(d) - t.minorRadius;
}
```


### Capsule

Line segment with radius — hemispherical caps at endpoints:

```glsl
float sdCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float r) {
    vec3 pa = p - a, ba = b - a;
    float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * t) - r;
}
```

```glsl
struct Capsule {
    vec3 a;
    vec3 b;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Capsule c) {
    vec3 pa = p - c.a, ba = c.b - c.a;
    float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * t) - c.radius;
}
```


### Segment (3D)

Distance to a line segment. Always non-negative.

```glsl
float sdSegment(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b) {
    vec3 pa = p - a, ba = b - a;
    float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * t);
}
```


## Platonic Solids

### Octahedron

```glsl
float sdOctahedron(vec3 p, float s) {
    p = abs(p);
    return (p.x + p.y + p.z - s) * 0.57735027;
}
```

```glsl
struct Octahedron {
    vec3 center;
    float size;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Octahedron o) {
    vec3 q = abs(p - o.center);
    return (q.x + q.y + q.z - o.size) * 0.57735027;
}
```


### Tetrahedron

```glsl
float sdTetrahedron(vec3 p, float s) {
    p /= s;
    float m;
    m = min(p.x + p.y, 0.0); p.x -= m; p.y -= m;
    m = min(p.y + p.z, 0.0); p.y -= m; p.z -= m;
    m = min(p.x + p.y, 0.0); p.x -= m; p.y -= m;
    return (p.x + p.y + p.z - 1.0) * s * 0.57735027;
}
```

```glsl
struct Tetrahedron {
    vec3 center;
    float size;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Tetrahedron t) {
    vec3 q = (p - t.center) / t.size;
    float m;
    m = min(q.x + q.y, 0.0); q.x -= m; q.y -= m;
    m = min(q.y + q.z, 0.0); q.y -= m; q.z -= m;
    m = min(q.x + q.y, 0.0); q.x -= m; q.y -= m;
    return (q.x + q.y + q.z - 1.0) * t.size * 0.57735027;
}
```


### Icosahedron

```glsl
#define PHI (0.5 + 0.5 * sqrt(5.0))

float sdIcosahedron(vec3 p, float r) {
    p = abs(p);
    vec3 n1 = normalize(vec3(0, 1, PHI));
    vec3 n2 = normalize(vec3(1, PHI, 0));
    vec3 n3 = normalize(vec3(PHI, 0, 1));
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n1), 0.0) * n1;
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n2), 0.0) * n2;
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n3), 0.0) * n3;
    return (p.x + p.y + p.z - r) * 0.57735027;
}
```

```glsl
struct Icosahedron {
    vec3 center;
    float size;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Icosahedron ico) {
    vec3 q = abs(p - ico.center);
    vec3 n1 = normalize(vec3(0, 1, PHI));
    vec3 n2 = normalize(vec3(1, PHI, 0));
    vec3 n3 = normalize(vec3(PHI, 0, 1));
    q -= 2.0 * min(dot(q, n1), 0.0) * n1;
    q -= 2.0 * min(dot(q, n2), 0.0) * n2;
    q -= 2.0 * min(dot(q, n3), 0.0) * n3;
    return (q.x + q.y + q.z - ico.size) * 0.57735027;
}
```


### Dodecahedron

```glsl
float sdDodecahedron(vec3 p, float r) {
    p = abs(p);
    vec3 n1 = normalize(vec3(0, 1, PHI));
    vec3 n2 = normalize(vec3(1, PHI, 0));
    vec3 n3 = normalize(vec3(PHI, 0, 1));
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n1), 0.0) * n1;
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n2), 0.0) * n2;
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n3), 0.0) * n3;
    vec3 fn = normalize(vec3(0, 1.0/PHI, PHI));
    return dot(p, fn) - r;
}
```

```glsl
struct Dodecahedron {
    vec3 center;
    float size;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Dodecahedron dod) {
    vec3 q = abs(p - dod.center);
    vec3 n1 = normalize(vec3(0, 1, PHI));
    vec3 n2 = normalize(vec3(1, PHI, 0));
    vec3 n3 = normalize(vec3(PHI, 0, 1));
    q -= 2.0 * min(dot(q, n1), 0.0) * n1;
    q -= 2.0 * min(dot(q, n2), 0.0) * n2;
    q -= 2.0 * min(dot(q, n3), 0.0) * n3;
    vec3 fn = normalize(vec3(0, 1.0/PHI, PHI));
    return dot(q, fn) - dod.size;
}
```


## Quick Reference

All bare functions in one place for copy-paste:

```glsl
#define PHI (0.5 + 0.5 * sqrt(5.0))

// 2D
float sdCircle(vec2 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }
float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 h) { vec2 d = abs(p)-h; return length(max(d,0.0))+min(max(d.x,d.y),0.0); }
float sdSegment(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b) { vec2 pa=p-a,ba=b-a; float t=clamp(dot(pa,ba)/dot(ba,ba),0.0,1.0); return length(pa-ba*t); }

// 3D
float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }
float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 h) { vec3 d = abs(p)-h; return length(max(d,0.0))+min(max(d.x,max(d.y,d.z)),0.0); }
float sdPlane(vec3 p, float h) { return p.y - h; }
float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) { vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz)-r, abs(p.y)-h); return length(max(d,0.0))+min(max(d.x,d.y),0.0); }
float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) { return length(vec2(length(p.xz)-R, p.y)) - r; }
float sdCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float r) { vec3 pa=p-a,ba=b-a; return length(pa-ba*clamp(dot(pa,ba)/dot(ba,ba),0.0,1.0))-r; }
float sdOctahedron(vec3 p, float s) { p=abs(p); return (p.x+p.y+p.z-s)*0.57735027; }
```
